native_context: TLS service-identity and certificate validation in clients
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: TLS service-identity and certificate validation in clients — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect the actual TLS client configuration, trust store, reference hostname, SNI, redirect/proxy behavior and fallback branches. Record library/version and verification overrides.
controls.controlled_verification: Use local owned TLS fixtures: trusted matching peer, untrusted peer and wrong-name peer. Observe whether the application sends/accepts protected fixture data after each handshake, not simply whether a TCP connection opens. Preserve intended hostname when evaluating custom resolution.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Encryption alone does not authenticate the intended peer. A test using a different client/configuration is not evidence for the application, and a failed local fixture without a working valid control is inconclusive.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Enable supported chain and reference-identity validation at the real client without insecure fallback. Retest valid peer, untrusted/wrong-name peers and the original proxy/redirect path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
